about: The evangelium of the formulary “6th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, when a great multitude was with Jesus and they had nothing to eat, He summoned His disciples and said to them: I feel pity for the multitude, because, behold, for three days now they have stayed on with me, and they have nothing to eat; and if I let them go fasting to their homes, they will collapse on the road, for some of them came from far away. And His disciples replied to Him: From where will anyone be able to fill them with bread here in the wilderness? And He asked them: How many loaves do you have? They said: Seven. And He directed the multitude to sit down on the ground. And taking the seven loaves and giving thanks, He broke them and kept giving them to His disciples to serve; and they served them to the multitude. And they had a few small fish; and He blessed them too, and commanded them to be served. And they ate and were filled, and they picked up what remained of the fragments: seven baskets. And those who had eaten numbered about four thousand; and He let them go.
